rules.statement: A person can possess a property without occupying it, and to prove possession, it is not necessary to prove that he or she lives in the property or occupies it.
rules.supporting_quote: One can possess a property without occupying the same. To prove possession it is not necessary to prove that he or she lives in the property or occupies the property.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 328 of the Civil Procedure Code
